bead.title: Exercise API-003 worker flow from claimed fields in e2e
bead.description: PROBLEM: The API-003 scheduled-action e2e proves delivery semantics, but it does not yet force the worker-obligation flow to consume the claimed item's current structured fields after an `update_fields` mutation. ROOT CAUSE: `crates/pqueue/tests/product_validation_tests.rs:546` drives `scheduled_action_delivery_e2e`, yet the scenario does not currently assert that the worker can execute from the claimed item alone with the updated field map and no secondary queue-data lookup. PROPOSED FIX: extend the scheduled-action delivery e2e so it mutates `fields` before claim, then proves the worker-obligation path observes the current structured fields from the claimed item and completes the workflow without consulting any secondary storage system for queue data. This extends the closed claimed-shape work (`pqueue-9c77d5e7` / `pqueue-922eaf00`) and carries the API-003 obligation through to e2e evidence. NON-SCOPE: RESP wire output, backend-specific claim internals, and traceability-doc edits.
bead.acceptance:
1. TestScheduledDeliveryWorkerUsesClaimedFields: `cargo test -p pqueue --test product_validation_tests scheduled_action_delivery_e2e -- --nocapture` passes after the e2e drives API-003 work from the claimed item's fields alone.
2. TestScheduledDeliveryUpdateFieldsRoundTrip: the same e2e claims an item after `update_fields` and proves the worker-obligation path sees the current structured fields without a secondary queue-data lookup.
3. TestGoTestGate: `go test ./...` passes.
4. TestLefthookGate: `lefthook run pre-commit` passes.
